location_exception_reason: Portable classrooms are educational infrastructure products sold nationally; location names in titles (e.g., 'Delhi Portable Classroom') do not change the product's function or buyer decision criteria. Buyers select based on size, insulation type, and structural design, not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in portable classroom titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PUF Panel Portable Classroom Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship does not define what is being sold.
